query:
SELECT d.id AS "id!", count(s.id) AS "play_count!: i64", max(g.played_at) AS "last_played_at?: UtcDateTime"
           FROM decks d
           LEFT JOIN game_players s ON s.deck_id = d.id
           LEFT JOIN games g ON g.id = s.game_id
           WHERE d.player_id = ? AND d.archived_at IS NULL AND d.included_for_play
           GROUP BY d.id
           ORDER BY lower(d.name), d.id
